title: Posterior arterial variation: eight-volunteer comparison
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Compare the same arterial region across eight healthy-volunteer source examples. Record visible course, paired-side context, label coverage and the evidence supporting each interpretation.

views.prompt: Compare the left and right posterior communicating regions with the internal carotid and posterior cerebral segments. Follow candidate continuity through adjacent original sections. Describe the source side, image visibility and supplied posterior communicating labels separately. Use both sides and another volunteer as comparison contexts.
